name: Time Piece
author: gdeyoung
description: Time Piece — Omarchy's clock with the date in the bar label, a gear-opened settings view (city-search world clocks with categorical label hues, date toggle), a countdown timer, and a self-running pomodoro — redesigned timer section: 24px mm:ss hero readout, TIMER/POMODORO mode tabs, remaining-time bar, 4-block cycle rail, phase-colored states (focus/break/long break co-coded with words)

barWidget.description: Date/time label with a calendar popup
